question: Three agents discuss entropy in isolated systems. Which position is best supported?
options: Entropy measures the total energy of a system.
Living things are exempt from entropy increase.
The entropy of an isolated system never decreases.
Entropy always decreases as systems evolve.
gold_answer: The entropy of an isolated system never decreases.
notes: Team-authored original item on entropy in isolated systems. Passages are team-authored derivations recorded under sciclaim-appx-A. Requires independent annotation and adjudication before any gate result is reported.

positions.answer: Living things are exempt from entropy increase.

claims.text: Reversible processes keep total entropy constant.

evidence.text: An ideal reversible change produces no new entropy, holding the total fixed.

claims.verdict_rationale: The passage states reversible change produces no new entropy, which entails the claim.

evidence.text: Refrigerators move heat using work and increase total entropy, which the second law permits.

claims.verdict_rationale: The passage states refrigerators are permitted, which refutes the claim.

claims.text: All ordered structures are physically impossible.

evidence.text: Crystal growth rates were measured under controlled cooling.

claims.verdict_rationale: Measuring growth rates cannot show order is impossible, so the claim is neither established nor refuted.

positions.answer: Entropy always decreases as systems evolve.

claims.text: Isolated systems evolve toward higher-entropy states.

evidence.text: Statistics favor macrostates with more microstates, so entropy rises toward its maximum.

claims.verdict_rationale: The passage derives rising entropy from microstate counting, which entails the claim.

claims.text: Entropy is a measure of energy content.

evidence.text: Entropy counts the dispersal of energy among microstates, not the total energy present.

claims.verdict_rationale: The passage defines entropy as dispersal, not content, which refutes the claim.

claims.text: Entropy can be destroyed with enough effort.

evidence.text: Energy inputs were logged for the ordering process in the experiment.

claims.verdict_rationale: Logging inputs cannot show entropy was destroyed, so the claim is neither established nor refuted.

positions.answer: The entropy of an isolated system never decreases.

claims.text: Local order can grow only by exporting more disorder elsewhere.

evidence.text: A refrigerator cools its interior by dumping greater heat into the room, raising total entropy.

claims.verdict_rationale: The passage shows local cooling paid for with greater total entropy, which entails the claim.

claims.text: Evolution violates the second law of thermodynamics.

evidence.text: Earth receives low-entropy sunlight and radiates high-entropy heat, so local complexity grows with rising total entropy.

claims.verdict_rationale: The passage reconciles complexity with rising total entropy, which refutes the claim.

claims.text: Entropy proves the universe is infinitely old.

evidence.text: Cosmological models were compared on several independent lines of evidence.

claims.verdict_rationale: Comparing models cannot prove infinite age from entropy, so the claim is neither established nor refuted.
